text:
sophie: FYI I'm seeing a sharp spike (~25x) in fnhook validation failures on /generate in us-west starting 11:07.
kevin: Oof. Do we have the raw validator messages?
sophie: Quick tail from the validator stream:
```
2026-01-20T11:07:02Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error="schema mismatch: expected OBJECT but received ARRAY" sample=ef001
2026-01-20T11:07:03Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error="toolcall shape invalid: missing 'name' field" sample=ef002
```
maria: Common pattern: when prompts ask for bulleted steps the model sometimes emits a top-level list. Our coercion glue (permissive=true) was trying to map list entries to toolcall objects and that trips strict validation.
kevin: We rolled permissive coercion on for canary us-west in rollout v0.15. Could be the root cause.
sophie: The console marks these as "rejected" but we can't see the shape type or sample payload without hopping into logs. That slows down ops.
ops-oncall: Are these being billed as fncall? If customers are charged it's urgent to mute alerts.
sophie: First sample shows billing_tag=fncall, route=default, fallback=routing.degen. Customers may be billed.
maria: Mitigation proposal: (1) bump validator sampling to 100% for /generate in us-west for 10 min, (2) disable coercion-permissive on canary in that region, (3) add an ephemeral console panel that surfaces validator.shape=ARRAY spikes and links to up-to-3 live examples.
kevin: I'll toggle sampling and enqueue a rollback for coercion-permissive. Deploy-bot, enqueue rollback job for canary us-west (actor=kevin).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by kevin  id=9902 scheduled immediate.
sophie: If rollback reduces rejects we'll need a small console change: tooltip should show "shape sample" and offer a one-click copy to paste into tickets. Also add a billing_exempt override for soft-degrades so we can avoid false-positive billing alerts while triaging.
maria: For telemetry, add metric name validator.shape_type with labels {route,region,validator} and a top_examples link (hashed ids). Also emit validator.reject_reason to make dashboards less noisy.
kevin: Creating follow-up ENG-19001: dashboard tile + metric + billing-exempt flag + console tooltip. Sophie, after sampling is up attach 3 representative sample ids to the ticket.
sophie: Will attach once sampling ramps. Early signal post-rollback shows rejects falling but still noisy; keeping 100% sampling for 10m and will paste 3 samples into ENG-19001. ops-oncall: please mute billing alarms for route=/generate us-west during triage.
ops-oncall: Muting billing alerts for /generate in us-west for 60m (mute id: m-4610).
sophie: Thread note: thread_ts=1762234000. Will report back when sampling window closes. :thumbsup:
